method: Population: Kickstarter projects in the webrobots.io dump of 2026-10-12, state successful or failed, launched 2019-01-01 to 2023-12-31 (UTC), one record per project id. 500 drawn per main category in proportion (at least 1 each, seed 0), split 250 tune / 250 held-out stratified by state (seed 0). Knos sees one line: 'name: blurb' cut to 200 characters, then ' (main/sub category)' (neither API has a category field). Predictor (a): verdict of POST /api/open-signals; (b): decision.verdict of POST /api/check (open signals + Qloo). A 400 counts as REFUSE. Tuned on the tune half and nothing else: per predictor, whether OPEN predicts success or failure (the more accurate one; a tie keeps OPEN = success); every other verdict predicts the opposite. Scored on the held-out half: accuracy, the majority-class base rate, exact binomial p (one-sided, accuracy above the base rate), Fisher's exact p (two-sided).

source.name: webrobots.io Kickstarter datasets, the dump of 2026-10-12 (JSON)
